notes: A REDESIGNED SCREEN: sharper text (on Windows the app now uses Segoe UI, the Windows interface font, made to stay crisp on an ordinary office monitor; on a Mac, Inter), one size larger; explanations and forms use the full width of the page; tables fit the screen and line up, with dates, voucher numbers and amounts on one line and small tidy buttons on each row; registers with many columns scroll inside their own panel; summary figures are never cut off. Nothing in your books changes, no feature moves, and printed documents keep their layout. Installing: no new tables. Please still take a backup first: Backup and Export, Back up now.
